scripts.//: The default bundle: the element and codejar, no highlighter — a docs site that already loads highlight.js should not ship a second copy.
The same element with highlight.js bundled in, for a page that has none. Same options as above, so the only difference between the two bundles is the entry file.

styles.//: Plain css in, plain css out — the point is a shipped dist/ that a consumer can link without a build of their own.
Optional syntax colours, kept separate so a site with its own theme is not overridden.

copy.//: The example page loads no highlighter of its own, so it takes the bundle that brings one. No code-preview-hljs.css either — the docs theme colours the tokens, which is the case the separate stylesheet exists to allow.

The prose layout links css/prose.min.css. Prebuilt, so the example does not compile the theme's scss to use one page of it — and only the prose half of it, since the docs bundle is an alternative, not a layer.

site.title: code-preview
site.description: A code block that renders itself: live, editable HTML samples in an isolated iframe.
